name: Aquatic Passengers
jem_summary: Successfully capture and safely release an eligible aquatic creature; house an octopus in a Nautilus Shell.

pages.title: Aquatic Passengers
pages.text: Successfully capture and safely release an eligible aquatic creature; house an octopus in a Nautilus Shell.

pages.title: Aquatic Passengers
pages.text: Reefstone and two coral materials provide a fitting palette for the new safe pool.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Small fish fit buckets and some creatures fit the Casting Net; check each native entry. Large adult fish reject buckets. Octopus housing uses the supported Nautilus Shell, not an empty-net click.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Explore Spawn Overworld biomes, animals and ambient features. Mod-wide exploration activities beyond item collection.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use JEI to discover special Spawn recipes where registered. Guide can teach the native recipe interface.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Jade integration supplies information for some specialized Spawn interactions such as stickbugs and octopus-locked chests. Potential in-game inspection tutorial.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use Casting Nets, buckets or a Nautilus Shell according to the native animal entry and growth stage. Large adults may reject buckets while certain smaller creatures fit.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use Casting Net for compatible sea creatures, or capture an Octopus in Nautilus Shell. The native advancement recognizes multi-mob catches and shell housing; Clams may also be collected by hand.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Bucket Herring, Pilot Fish, Blenny or Seahorse in their documented habitats. Herring school, Pilot Fish circle larger creatures, Blenny flee in Tide Pools and Seahorses vary with habitat.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Avoid injuring nearby creatures around Bluefish. Nearby hurt mobs can provoke its feeding frenzy in ocean/cold-ocean habitats.
